title: SPARC: Accurate Photonic Matrix Multiplication via Representative Vectors
abstract: arXiv:2611.16561v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Photonic neural network accelerators have emerged as a promising solution for reducing the power consumption of deep neural network (DNN) inference by executing matrix multiplication on analog photonic hardware. However, their inference accuracy is limited by low-bit quantization required for photonic processing and by analog photonic noise. This paper proposes an approach for improving inference accuracy by exploiting the high similarity among activation vectors in DNNs. Specifically, our approach constructs a representative vector for each group of similar activation vectors, computes its inner product digitally with high precision, and offloads the residual inner products to the photonic accelerator. Since the activation vectors within each group are highly similar, the residual vectors have much smaller norms, thereby reducing the effects of quantization errors and analog photonic noise. tldr: 该论文提出SPARC方法，通过为相似的激活向量组构建代表性向量并以高精度数字计算其内积、仅将范数更小的残差内积交给光子加速器处理，从而有效降低量化误差和模拟光子噪声对推理精度的影响。
en_tdlr: SPARC constructs a representative vector for each group of similar activation vectors and computes its inner product digitally with high precision, offloading only the much smaller residual inner products to the photonic accelerator, thereby mitigating quantization errors and analog photonic noise for accurate photonic matrix multiplication.
